text:
I could not confirm any 2006 award for *Avatar: The Last Airbender*, and neither candidate in the team note checks out for that year. My search points to a 2007 Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Individual Achievement in Animation (per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2)) and a 2008 Kids' Choice Award for Favorite Cartoon (per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kids%27_Choice_Award_for_Favorite_Cartoon)), but the search summary was garbled and I did not open those pages to confirm the details. I also did not find any source for the team note's "Outstanding Voice-Over Performance" Emmy.

CONFIDENCE: 20
